## Orgainse | Delivery Governance Consulting and PMaaS

URL: https://www.orgainse.com/
Summary: Delivery consulting, Project Management as a Service (PMaaS) and the ORQYNE platform that turn fragmented work into governed execution. Serving the US, India, UK, Europe, the Middle East and Australia.

Delivery Governance Consulting · PMaaS · ORQYNE Software
Turn Fragmented Work Into Visible, Governed Execution
Build stronger delivery systems, improve operational visibility, and apply Artificial Intelligence where it creates measurable business value.
Orgainse helps Information Technology services companies, software teams, startups, and growing businesses move from disconnected tools and reactive reporting to structured, accountable execution. We combine business consulting, Project Management as a Service (PMaaS), workflow transformation, and ORQYNE to help teams establish clearer ownership, stronger governance, reliable reporting, and better-informed decisions.
Whether the starting point is one critical project, a growing delivery portfolio, or an organisation-wide workflow problem, we help define the operating model, configure the right systems, and support adoption through execution.

Built Around Real Business Work
Strategy Is Not the Problem. Execution Usually Is.
Most growing organisations do not suffer from a shortage of ideas, tools, or meetings. They struggle because work is fragmented, ownership is unclear, risks surface late, reporting is inconsistent, and leaders spend too much time reconstructing what is happening. Orgainse helps create an execution system that makes priorities, responsibilities, dependencies, decisions, progress, and risks easier to see and manage.
Poor Visibility
Leaders cannot quickly see what is on track, what is blocked, what requires a decision, or where delivery is drifting.
Weak Ownership
Responsibilities are spread across people, chats, spreadsheets, and tools without one accountable operating model.
Reactive Reporting
Status updates consume time but still fail to provide reliable decision context.
Workflow Leakage
Handoffs, approvals, dependencies, and follow-ups are missed because the process is not visible or governed.
Founder Overload
Founders and senior leaders become the operating system because the business has not built one.
Low Execution Certainty
Plans exist, but teams lack the cadence, controls, and evidence required to deliver with confidence.
The objective is not to add another tool. The objective is to create greater execution certainty.
What we do
Services Built Around Execution, Not Activity
Start with the business outcome that matters most. Orgainse combines focused advisory, implementation, and operating support so that strategy is translated into visible, repeatable execution.
Project Management as a Service (PMaaS)
Add structured project leadership without building a full internal Project Management Office. Orgainse supports planning, governance, reporting cadence, risk and dependency management, stakeholder communication, and executive visibility. ORQYNE can be configured as the shared delivery workspace for the engagement.
Artificial Intelligence and Workflow Transformation
Identify where Artificial Intelligence, automation, and workflow redesign can remove friction or improve decision quality. We map current processes, identify high-value opportunities, define human approval points, and establish a practical implementation roadmap before technology is introduced.
Delivery and Operational Governance
Create a consistent operating rhythm across projects, teams, and business functions. This includes portfolio visibility, responsibilities, escalation paths, risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, decisions, resource visibility, cost oversight, and executive reporting.
ORQYNE Implementation and Adoption
Configure ORQYNE around the way your organisation actually operates. We support workspace design, roles and access, workflow configuration, work import, templates, governance controls, integrations, onboarding, and adoption reviews.
Artificial Intelligence Strategy and Readiness
Determine where Artificial Intelligence can create value before committing significant budget. Orgainse assesses business priorities, process maturity, data availability, operating risk, governance requirements, and adoption readiness to develop a sequenced implementation plan.
Healthcare Revenue Intelligence Advisory
Improve visibility into revenue performance, denial patterns, payer behaviour, operating controls, and executive reporting. Each engagement is separately scoped for data handling, regulatory considerations, and advisory boundaries. Orgainse does not position this service as operational medical billing or coding.

Answers
Frequently Asked Questions
Still evaluating? Write to info@orgainse.com or book a discovery call.
Schedule a Discovery Call
What does Orgainse do? Orgainse helps organisations improve project delivery, workflow visibility, operational governance, and practical Artificial Intelligence adoption. Services include Project Management as a Service, delivery and workflow transformation, ORQYNE implementation, Artificial Intelligence readiness, and separately scoped advisory engagements.
What is Project Management as a Service? Project Management as a Service (PMaaS) gives an organisation access to structured project leadership, governance, reporting, risk management, stakeholder communication, and delivery support without immediately building a full Internal Project Management Office.
How is Orgainse different from a conventional consulting firm? Orgainse combines advisory, implementation, operating support, and ORQYNE. The engagement is designed to move from recommendation to an operating workflow with defined owners, controls, reporting, and adoption support.
What is an outsourced PMO? An outsourced Project Management Office (PMO) gives you the governance, reporting cadence, risk and dependency management and portfolio visibility of an internal PMO, delivered by an external partner. Orgainse provides this through Project Management as a Service, scoped to one critical project or a whole delivery portfolio.
What is delivery governance for Information Technology services firms? It is the operating rhythm that keeps client delivery visible and controlled: named owners, escalation paths, Risk, Assumption, Issue and Dependency (RAID) registers, decision and change records, resource and margin visibility, and an executive view of delivery health across every engagement.
What is ORQYNE? ORQYNE is project portfolio and delivery governance software built by Orgainse. It brings projects, portfolios, RAID registers, decisions, knowledge and Artificial Intelligence-assisted workflows into one governed workspace, and is implemented with Orgainse support rather than left for customers to configure alone.
How can delivery teams adopt Artificial Intelligence practically? Begin with one workflow where time or quality is visibly lost, such as status reporting or RAID upkeep. Map the process, define where Artificial Intelligence assists and where a person approves, agree success measures, and pilot before scaling.
Does Orgainse offer healthcare revenue cycle analytics? Yes, as independent advisory. Orgainse analyses revenue performance, denial patterns, payer behaviour and operating controls over your existing revenue cycle operations. It does not provide medical billing, coding, claims processing or collections.
Who is Orgainse designed to support? Orgainse primarily supports Information Technology services firms, software teams, startups, small and medium-sized enterprises, and cross-functional operating teams that need better visibility, governance, and execution discipline.
Does Orgainse guarantee delivery improvement or Return on Investment? No. Timing and outcomes depend on scope, data quality, leadership decisions, adoption, integrations, operating conditions, and customer responsibilities. Success measures are agreed before work begins and reviewed through the engagement.
Can Orgainse support a company that already uses Jira, Asana, monday.com, or another work-management platform? Yes. Orgainse can improve the operating model around an existing tool, introduce ORQYNE for selected workflows, or assess whether consolidation is justified. The recommendation is based on business fit rather than forced replacement.

What it does
Orgainse provides the project leadership layer your delivery needs without you having to stand up a full internal Project Management Office. We take responsibility for planning, the reporting rhythm, risk and dependency management, stakeholder communication, and the executive view of delivery health.
What you receive
An agreed operating model with defined roles and responsibilities, a reporting cadence, RAID registers, decision and approval records, resource and cost visibility, and an executive view of delivery health. Where useful, ORQYNE is configured as the shared workspace for the engagement.
Why it works
The engagement is designed to move from recommendation to an operating workflow. Owners, controls, reporting and escalation paths are defined and then actually run, rather than handed over as a document.
Delivered with ORQYNE : ORQYNE project portfolio and delivery governance software

Frequently Asked Questions
Scope, engagement model, boundaries, and how pricing is determined.
1
Scope and Engagement
What does Orgainse actually do?
Orgainse helps organisations improve project delivery, workflow visibility, operational governance, and practical Artificial Intelligence adoption. Services include Project Management as a Service, Artificial Intelligence and workflow transformation, delivery and operational governance, ORQYNE implementation and adoption, Artificial Intelligence strategy and readiness, and separately scoped Healthcare Revenue Intelligence Advisory.
What is Project Management as a Service?
Project Management as a Service (PMaaS) gives an organisation access to structured project leadership, governance, reporting, risk management, stakeholder communication, and delivery support without immediately building a full internal Project Management Office. It can be scoped to one critical project or to a delivery portfolio.
What is an outsourced PMO, and when does it make sense?
An outsourced Project Management Office (PMO) provides the governance, reporting cadence, Risk, Assumption, Issue and Dependency (RAID) management and portfolio visibility of an internal PMO, delivered by an external partner. It suits organisations whose delivery portfolio has outgrown informal coordination but who are not yet ready to hire and run a permanent PMO team. Orgainse delivers this through Project Management as a Service.
How is Orgainse different from a conventional consulting firm?
Orgainse combines advisory, implementation, operating support, and ORQYNE. The engagement is designed to move from recommendation to an operating workflow with defined owners, controls, reporting, and adoption support, rather than ending at a deck.
Who does Orgainse work with?
Primarily Information Technology services firms, software delivery teams, startups, small and medium-sized enterprises, and cross-functional operating teams. Typical buyers are founders, Chief Executive Officers, Chief Operating Officers, delivery leaders, project leaders, operations heads, and business owners.
2
How Engagements Run
How does an engagement start?
It starts with a focused discovery session on one important execution problem. We clarify the desired outcome, current workflow, decision owners, operating constraints, and the most practical next step. The recommendation may involve consulting, Project Management as a Service, ORQYNE, a short diagnostic, or no immediate engagement.
What are the four stages of delivery?
Diagnose: clarify the desired outcome, current workflow, decision owners, constraints, risks, and measurable sources of leakage. Design: create the target workflow, governance model, reporting rhythm, roles, controls, and success measures. Implement: configure the process, ORQYNE workspace, templates, integrations, and operating cadence. Govern: review adoption, risks, decisions, delivery health, and measurable outcomes on a defined schedule.
What does delivery governance look like for an Information Technology services firm?
For an Information Technology services firm, delivery governance means every client engagement runs on the same operating rhythm: clear owners and escalation paths, RAID registers, change and decision records, resource and margin visibility, and an executive view of delivery health across the portfolio. The aim is to see drift early enough to act, without adding reporting overhead.
How can delivery teams adopt Artificial Intelligence practically?
Start with one workflow where time or quality is visibly lost, such as status reporting, RAID upkeep or meeting follow-ups. Map the current process, decide where Artificial Intelligence assists and where a person approves, agree success measures, then pilot before scaling. Orgainse supports this through Artificial Intelligence strategy and readiness and workflow transformation engagements.
Can Orgainse work with our existing tools?
Yes. Orgainse can improve the operating model around an existing tool such as Jira, Asana or monday.com, introduce ORQYNE for selected workflows, or assess whether consolidation is justified. The recommendation is based on business fit rather than forced replacement, and integration availability is confirmed during scoping.
How is Artificial Intelligence introduced safely?
We map the process first, identify where Artificial Intelligence improves decision quality or removes friction, and define human approval points before anything is built. Artificial Intelligence output may be incomplete or incorrect, so material operational, financial, legal, security, healthcare, or employment decisions retain appropriate human review.
3
What is Healthcare Revenue Intelligence Advisory?
It is an advisory and analytics service that improves visibility into revenue performance, denial patterns, payer behaviour, operating controls, and executive reporting. It works alongside your existing revenue cycle operations and vendors rather than replacing them. Each engagement is separately scoped for data handling, regulatory considerations, and advisory boundaries.
What is healthcare revenue cycle analytics?
Healthcare revenue cycle analytics is the analysis of revenue cycle data, including claims, denials, payer behaviour, collections and operating controls, to show where revenue performance is weakening and why. Orgainse provides it as independent advisory and analytics over your existing revenue cycle operations; it does not perform billing, coding or claims work.
Who is the right fit for this service?
Organisations that already have revenue cycle operations in place, internally or through a third party, and need an independent view of what those operations are delivering and where performance can be strengthened through better governance, analytics, or technology readiness.
What is explicitly not included?
Orgainse does not provide medical billing or claims submission, medical coding or clinical documentation, accounts receivable follow-up or collections, denial follow-up or appeal submission, payment posting or remittance processing, patient billing, or onshore and offshore revenue cycle staffing. The scope is strictly advisory, analytics, and governance.
4
Pricing, Outcomes and Data
How is pricing determined?
Pricing depends on scope, engagement duration, the services involved, the operating support required, and — where ORQYNE is included — users, enabled modules, implementation requirements, Artificial Intelligence usage model, and integration scope. Final scope and commercial terms are confirmed in writing before work begins.
Does Orgainse guarantee delivery improvement or Return on Investment?
No. Timing and outcomes depend on scope, data quality, leadership decisions, adoption, integrations, operating conditions, and customer responsibilities. Success measures are agreed before work begins and reviewed through the engagement, and we deliberately do not publish guaranteed percentages.
Are the assessment and calculator on this site an audit?
No. The Artificial Intelligence readiness assessment and the Return on Investment calculator are directional planning aids based entirely on the answers and assumptions you supply. They are not a certification, an audit, or professional advice for your specific circumstances.
How is our data handled?
Data handling, access, retention, and confidentiality are defined in the engagement agreement, and Healthcare engagements are separately scoped for regulatory considerations. Orgainse does not claim certification or legal compliance under any standard unless it has been formally established and independently verified.

Delivery consulting, Project Management as a Service and delivery governance
Orgainse is a delivery-execution partner for Information Technology services firms , software teams , startups and growing businesses. We work on one operating condition: service-led, cross-functional work that needs stronger execution visibility and governance . Engagements combine consulting, Project Management as a Service , workflow transformation and implementation of ORQYNE , our delivery-governance workspace.
The problem we work on is narrow and specific: work is spread across disconnected tools, status is reconstructed manually, ownership is unclear, risks surface late, and decisions are made without a reliable view of delivery health. Our role is to replace that with structured operating rhythms — named owners, tracked risks and actions, agreed reporting cadence and a single view leadership can rely on.
Orgainse was founded in 2025 and operates from Austin, Texas (headquarters) and Bengaluru, India (corporate office). We do not publish guaranteed percentages, savings figures or delivery improvements. Success measures are agreed in writing before work begins and reviewed through the engagement.
How we work
Agreed measures, not promises
Every engagement is scoped around measures both sides agree on up front — delivery health, decision turnaround, forecast reliability — reviewed at an agreed cadence.
Visible, governed execution
Risks, actions, dependencies and owners are tracked in one place, so status is a by-product of the work instead of a weekly reporting exercise.
Practitioners, not observers
Delivery leads and governance practitioners who sit inside the operating rhythm, run the cadence and hand it back to your team as a repeatable standard.
Where we work
Offices in Austin, Texas and Bengaluru, India, working a hybrid model and serving clients globally.
What engagements cover
Work is scoped to a defined execution problem rather than a broad transformation programme. A typical engagement moves through four stages — Diagnose , Design , Implement and Govern — and stops where the agreed scope stops.
Project leadership and governance
Structured project leadership, reporting cadence, risk and dependency management and executive visibility — without immediately building a full internal Project Management Office.
Workflow transformation
Process mapping, hand-off redesign, ownership definition and adoption support, with Artificial Intelligence applied only where it removes a specific manual step.
ORQYNE implementation
Configuring ORQYNE as the shared delivery workspace — portfolios, registers, reporting and operating rhythm — with service-backed rollout and adoption.
Who we work with
We do not organise around industry verticals. The common condition across our clients is service-led, cross-functional delivery where multiple teams, vendors or clients depend on each other and execution visibility is the constraint.
Information Technology services & software
Multi-client delivery portfolios, distributed squads and commitments that need reliable status, capacity and risk visibility.
A separately scoped advisory and analytics engagement: denial trend analysis, payer behaviour insight and revenue-cycle governance advisory.
Right fit: organisations with revenue cycle operations already in place that need an independent view of revenue performance and governance. Not the right fit: outsourced billing, coding, accounts-receivable follow-up, claims processing or operational revenue cycle delivery — Orgainse does not provide these services.
Startups & growing businesses
Teams that have outgrown informal coordination and need delivery ownership, governance and reporting before headcount.

## ORQYNE: Project Portfolio and Delivery Governance Software

URL: https://www.orgainse.com/products
Summary: Explore ORQYNE, a service-backed platform connecting projects, workflows, governance, knowledge, analytics, and Artificial Intelligence assistance for Information Technology delivery and business operations.

ORQYNE · Project Portfolio and Delivery Governance Software by Orgainse
Delivery Governance for Teams That Have Outgrown Task Tracking
ORQYNE is a service-backed, multi-tenant platform that connects project execution, portfolio visibility, governance, team knowledge, decisions, and Artificial Intelligence-assisted workflows. It is designed for Information Technology services and software delivery teams as well as cross-functional business operations that need more than lists of tasks. ORQYNE helps establish a shared operating environment where work, ownership, risks, costs, decisions, and business context can be viewed together.
Orgainse supports configuration, implementation, workflow design, governance, and adoption. The product and service model work together so customers are not left to configure a complex operating system alone.

Start With the Operating Model, Not a Blank Tool
1 Map the Workflow
Document the work types, ownership, handoffs, decisions, governance, reporting, and success measures.
2 Configure the Experience
Select the relevant ORQYNE experience and configure terminology, roles, modules, workflows, templates, and controls.
3 Import and Validate Work
Use structured imports or templates to move existing projects and work items into the platform. Data is reviewed before it becomes part of the operating workspace.
4 Operate and Improve
Run work through ORQYNE, review adoption and delivery health, and refine the operating model using real usage and outcome data.
Artificial Intelligence Assistance Grounded in the Knowledge Your Team Approves
ORQYNE can use Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to retrieve relevant information from approved tenant documents, project records, decisions, and operating knowledge before producing an Artificial Intelligence-assisted response. This gives Artificial Intelligence workflows more organisational context than a generic chatbot. Access, model selection, approvals, and data sources remain governed by the customer's workspace configuration.
Index
Approved documents and work records are added to the tenant knowledge environment.
Retrieve
Relevant passages are selected based on the user's request and access permissions.
Generate
The configured model uses the retrieved context to prepare an answer, summary, recommendation, or draft.
Review
Users review important outputs before decisions, external communication, or system actions are completed.
Artificial Intelligence output may be incomplete or incorrect. Material operational, financial, legal, security, healthcare, or employment decisions must retain appropriate human review.
Industry-Scoped Agents for Delivery and Operations
Project Advisor
Supports schedule, scope, Earned Value Management interpretation, forecasting, and project reporting using available tenant context.
RAID Analyst
Helps organise and review Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies, including scoring, ownership, staleness, and mitigation context.
Vendor Intelligence
Supports vendor scorecards, renewal visibility, bid evaluation, total-cost analysis, and contract-related operating context.
Governance Copilot
Supports policy, control, audit-evidence, approval, and governance workflows as a starting point for qualified professional review.
Site Reliability Engineering and Incident Assistant
Supports incident triage, runbook retrieval, service-level context, incident analysis, and post-incident documentation.
Canvas Business-Function Agents
Canvas provides an agent catalogue designed around delivery, operations, finance, marketing, sales, people, legal, procurement, and portfolio management.
Custom agent builder
Where enabled, customers can configure agent instructions, inputs, data access, triggers, autonomy levels, and approval requirements.
See ORQYNE AI Capabilities Discuss Agent Governance
Connect the Systems That Already Hold Your Delivery Signals
ORQYNE includes a growing connector catalogue spanning source control, project management, Information Technology service management, observability, communications, customer systems, finance, human resources, and business operations. Connector availability, direction of data flow, authentication method, and production status vary by integration. Required integrations should be confirmed during the pilot or implementation scope.
Source Control
Connect relevant repository and development signals where supported.
Project Management
Import, synchronise, or reference work-management records according to connector capability.
IT Service Management
Bring incidents, service requests, changes, and operating records into delivery context.
Observability
Use supported monitoring and incident signals to strengthen project and service visibility.
Communications
Connect relevant collaboration channels and notifications according to approved access.
Business Systems
Use supported customer, finance, human resources, legal, and procurement connections for cross-functional workflows.
Keep Delivery Conversations Closer to the Work
ORQYNE supports project and team collaboration through channels, direct messages, mentions, notifications, presence, comments, and agent-assisted conversations. Teams can connect discussions to the relevant project, work item, sprint, document, or decision so that operating context is easier to retain.
Advanced retention, threaded discussions, compliance exports, and administrative controls vary by plan and current product availability.

Built With Tenant Awareness and Operational Safeguards
Role-Based Access Control
Role-Based Access Control, custom roles, and permission matrices help restrict access according to responsibilities.
Tenant-Aware Data Model
Tenant-scoped records and optional physical collection segregation support different customer isolation requirements.
Identity Controls
Multi-Factor Authentication is enforced for platform administration. Tenant-level Single Sign-On options are supported.
Audit and Secret Management
Audit records, environment-based secrets management, encryption services, and administrative controls support traceability and operational security.
Environment Separation
Development, staging, and production environments are independently deployed and operated.
Artificial Intelligence Governance
Provider configuration, agent autonomy, approval gates, and access controls support governed use of Artificial Intelligence workflows.
These controls do not represent an independent certification or a guarantee of compliance. Applicability to the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act, General Data Protection Regulation, System and Organization Controls 2, International Organization for Standardization 27001, or other requirements depends on configuration, contracts, operating procedures, customer responsibilities, and independent professional review.
Answers
Frequently Asked Questions
Still evaluating? Write to support@orgainse.com or request a guided pilot.
Schedule a Product Discussion
What is ORQYNE? ORQYNE is a multi-tenant delivery-governance platform by Orgainse. It brings projects, workflows, knowledge, decisions, governance, analytics, and Artificial Intelligence-assisted execution into one operating environment.
Is ORQYNE project portfolio management (PPM) software? Yes. ORQYNE covers the core of project portfolio management: portfolios, projects, backlogs and sprints, Risk, Assumption, Issue and Dependency (RAID) registers, Earned Value Management, resource and cost visibility, and executive reporting. It adds delivery governance controls and Artificial Intelligence assistance grounded in approved workspace knowledge.
Who should consider ORQYNE as their project portfolio software? Information Technology services firms, software delivery organisations and cross-functional operating teams that run several projects at once and need one governed view of delivery health, decisions and risk rather than scattered task lists and status decks.
Is ORQYNE a replacement for Jira, Asana, monday.com, or ClickUp? Not necessarily. ORQYNE can operate as the primary workspace for selected teams or complement existing systems through imports and connectors. The decision depends on workflow complexity, governance requirements, migration effort, and integration availability.
Who is ORQYNE designed for? The primary experience is designed for Information Technology services and software-delivery organisations. Canvas Business Management supports cross-functional operating teams and business departments.
How does ORQYNE use customer data for Artificial Intelligence? Approved tenant content can be indexed and retrieved to provide context for Artificial Intelligence-assisted outputs. Access and provider configuration are controlled at the workspace level.
Can customers use their own Artificial Intelligence provider? ORQYNE supports Bring Your Own Key configurations for supported providers, subject to plan and implementation scope. A platform-managed model configuration may also be available.
Which integrations are available? ORQYNE has a growing catalogue of connectors. Production availability, authentication, read or write capability, and commercial inclusion should be confirmed for each required integration.
Is ORQYNE compliant with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act, System and Organization Controls 2, or International Organization for Standardization 27001? Orgainse does not claim certification or legal compliance unless it has been formally established and independently verified. ORQYNE includes security and governance controls that may support a customer's compliance programme when combined with appropriate configuration, contracts, processes, and customer controls.
How should a company start? Start with one live project or workflow, define measurable success criteria, configure the relevant experience, and assess usage and operating value before expanding.
Evaluate ORQYNE on Real Work
Bring one active project, delivery workflow, or cross-functional operating problem. Orgainse will help define the success measures, configure an initial ORQYNE workspace, import relevant work, and evaluate whether the platform improves visibility, governance, and adoption before a wider rollout.
Prefer to browse first? Open the ORQYNE product site or read about Orgainse services .

## About Orgainse | Delivery Consulting, Austin and Bengaluru

URL: https://www.orgainse.com/about
Summary: Orgainse is an execution partner for IT services firms, software teams, startups and growing businesses — combining consulting, Project Management as a Service, workflow transformation and the ORQYNE delivery-governance platform.

About Orgainse
An execution partner for organisations that need visibility, governance, and practical Artificial Intelligence adoption.
Orgainse helps Information Technology services companies, software teams, startups, and growing businesses move from disconnected tools and reactive reporting to structured, accountable execution. We combine business consulting, Project Management as a Service, workflow transformation, and ORQYNE — our delivery-governance platform — so that ownership, governance, reporting and decisions become easier to see and manage.
From our offices in Austin and Bengaluru, we work with clients across the globe — including the United States, India, the United Kingdom and Europe, the Middle East, and Australia and New Zealand. Technology is introduced only where it improves the operating model.
Founded in 2025. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, USA , with our corporate office in Bengaluru, India.
A service-backed model : advisory, implementation, and operating support — not recommendations alone.
Human-governed Artificial Intelligence, with approval points designed in from the start.
Governance Visibility AI readiness Adoption Reporting Decisions Orgainse Execution partner
Core Consulting PMaaS ORQYNE
Illustration of the Orgainse engagement model. No client data is shown.
How Orgainse Works
Four connected stages that take an organisation from a business problem to an operating system with defined owners, controls, reporting, and measurable outcomes.
Diagnose
Stage one
Clarify the desired outcome, the current workflow, the decision owners, the operating constraints, the risks, and the measurable sources of leakage — before anything is designed or bought.
Output · Agreed problem statement
Design
Stage two
Create the target workflow, the governance model, the reporting rhythm, the roles, the controls, and the success measures — including where Artificial Intelligence genuinely improves decision quality and where a human approval point belongs.
Output · Target operating model
Implement
Stage three
Configure the process, the ORQYNE workspace, the templates, the integrations, and the operating cadence. Existing work is imported and validated before it becomes part of the live workspace.
Output · Configured workspace
Govern
Stage four
Review adoption, risks, decisions, delivery health, and measurable outcomes on a defined schedule — so the operating model keeps working after the engagement, not just during it.
Output · Reviewed delivery health
One continuous operating loop
Our Mission
To give growing organisations the execution certainty that usually only large enterprises can afford — clear ownership, dependable governance, honest reporting, and Artificial Intelligence applied where it genuinely improves a decision. We deliver advisory, implementation and operating support together, so a recommendation becomes a working operating model rather than a document.
Our Vision
A world where delivery is visible by default — where every team knows what is on track, what is blocked, who decides, and what it costs, and where Artificial Intelligence is adopted with governance rather than guesswork. We are building that operating standard through consulting, Project Management as a Service, and ORQYNE .
Our C.O.R.E. Values
The four principles that shape how every Orgainse engagement is scoped, run, and reviewed.
Collaborative
We work as an extension of your team, inside your operating rhythm, with clear ownership and shared visibility rather than parallel reporting.
Outcomes-focused
Success measures are agreed before work begins and reviewed through the engagement. We do not publish guaranteed percentages.
Reliable
A consistent operating cadence across time zones, with risks, decisions and delivery health reviewed on a defined schedule.
Excellence
Technology is introduced only where it improves the operating model, and material decisions retain appropriate human review.

## Privacy Policy | Orgainse

URL: https://www.orgainse.com/privacy
Summary: How Orgainse collects, uses, shares, retains, and protects personal information across its consulting, PMaaS, and ORQYNE implementation services.

Orgainse
Privacy Policy
Last updated · June 2026
Orgainse provides business consulting, Project Management as a Service (PMaaS), delivery and workflow transformation, Artificial Intelligence readiness advisory, and implementation support for the ORQYNE platform. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect through www.orgainse.com, why we collect it, how it is used, who it is shared with, how long it is retained, and the choices available to you.
1. Scope of This Policy
This policy applies to the Orgainse corporate website, our marketing communications, our lead-capture tools (contact forms, newsletter subscription, Artificial Intelligence readiness assessment, Return on Investment calculator, and consultation booking), and to information exchanged during pre-sales conversations.
Client project environments, contracted engagements, and the ORQYNE platform are governed by the separate agreements, data processing terms, and configuration decisions applicable to those engagements. Where the two overlap, the engagement contract prevails.
2. Information We Collect
We collect only what is required to respond to you and to operate the website.
Information you provide directly: name, business email address, telephone number, organisation name, role, region, service interest, and the content of your message or enquiry.
Assessment and calculator inputs: the answers and assumptions you submit so that we can return a directional result and, where requested, discuss it with you.
Subscription data: your email address, subscription source, subscription state, and any tags used to segment editorial content.
Technical data: internet protocol address, approximate region derived from it, browser and device type, referring page, and pages visited. This is used for security, performance, and aggregate analytics.
Cookie and consent data: your cookie preference and the date it was recorded.
We do not intentionally collect special category data, payment card data, government identifiers, or health information through this website. Please do not submit such information through our web forms.
3. Why We Process Your Information
Our legal bases, where the General Data Protection Regulation or comparable law applies, are: your consent (newsletter and non-essential cookies), our legitimate interests (responding to business enquiries, securing our systems), performance of a contract, and compliance with legal obligations.
To respond to enquiries, prepare proposals, and arrange discovery or consultation calls.
To deliver the resource, assessment result, or calculator scenario you requested.
To send the Orgainse newsletter and related editorial content where you have subscribed.
To operate, secure, and improve the website, including abuse prevention and rate limiting.
To meet legal, regulatory, accounting, and contractual obligations.
4. Artificial Intelligence and Automated Processing
Orgainse advises on Artificial Intelligence adoption and implements the ORQYNE platform. In relation to this website specifically, the Artificial Intelligence readiness assessment and Return on Investment calculator apply deterministic scoring and arithmetic to the values you enter. They do not make decisions about you, and they produce directional planning output only.
We do not use website enquiry content to train third-party foundation models. Where an engagement requires Artificial Intelligence processing of client material, the permitted data sources, model providers, retention, and human review points are defined in that engagement's contract and configuration.
5. Sharing and Disclosure
We do not sell, rent, or trade personal information. We share it only where necessary and under contract.
Service providers: website hosting and content delivery, database hosting, email delivery for transactional and newsletter messages, calendar scheduling, and product analytics.
Professional advisers: legal, accounting, insurance, and audit advisers where required.
Legal and regulatory recipients: where disclosure is required by law, court order, or to protect our rights, users, or systems.
Corporate transactions: in the event of a reorganisation, merger, or acquisition, subject to equivalent protection of your information.
6. International Transfers
Orgainse operates from the United States of America and India and serves clients across India, the United States, the United Kingdom, the United Arab Emirates, Australia, New Zealand, and South Africa. Your information may therefore be processed outside your country of residence. Where required, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses and equivalent contractual protections with our processors.
7. Retention
Enquiry and consultation records: retained for up to 36 months from the last interaction, unless a contract requires longer.
Newsletter subscriptions: retained until you unsubscribe, plus a suppression record so we do not contact you again in error.
Assessment and calculator submissions: retained for up to 24 months to support follow-up discussions.
Technical and security logs: retained for a short operational period consistent with security requirements.
8. Security
We apply administrative and technical measures proportionate to the sensitivity of the information we hold. These include transport encryption, hashed administrative credentials, role-based administrative access, brute-force protection with lockout, restricted cross-origin access, server-side sanitisation of submitted content, environment-based secret management, and separation of development and production environments.
No method of transmission or storage is completely secure. We do not represent that our controls constitute certification under any standard, and we ask that you avoid sending confidential material through web forms.
9. Your Rights and Choices
To exercise a right, write to support@orgainse.com with enough detail for us to identify your records. We may ask you to verify your identity before acting on a request.
Access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection, and portability, to the extent provided by applicable law.
Withdrawal of consent at any time, including one-click unsubscribe in every newsletter email.
Cookie choices through the consent banner presented on your first visit.
Complaint to your local supervisory authority where you consider your rights have not been respected.
10. Cookies and Similar Technologies
We use strictly necessary cookies for site operation and security, a preference cookie to remember your region and consent choice, and limited analytics to understand aggregate usage and performance. Non-essential cookies are set only after consent. You may clear or block cookies through your browser, although parts of the site may then behave differently.
11. Children
Our website and services are directed to businesses and professional users. We do not knowingly collect information from individuals under the age of 16. If you believe a child has provided information to us, contact support@orgainse.com and we will remove it.
12. Changes to This Policy
We may update this policy to reflect changes in our services, technology, or legal obligations. The revision date at the top of the document indicates the current version. Material changes will be highlighted on this page.
How to Contact Orgainse
Questions, requests, or complaints relating to this document can be sent to the addresses below. We aim to acknowledge written requests within five business days.
General enquiries: info@orgainse.com
Support and data requests: support@orgainse.com
Headquarters: Austin, Texas, United States of America

## Terms of Service | Orgainse

URL: https://www.orgainse.com/terms
Summary: The terms governing use of the Orgainse website, its informational tools, and the framework for consulting, PMaaS, and ORQYNE implementation engagements.

Orgainse
Terms of Service
Last updated · June 2026
These Terms of Service govern your use of the Orgainse website and the informational tools published on it. They also describe the general framework within which Orgainse provides consulting, Project Management as a Service, workflow transformation, Artificial Intelligence readiness advisory, and ORQYNE implementation support. Paid engagements are always governed by a separate signed agreement, statement of work, or order form.
1. Acceptance
By accessing www.orgainse.com, submitting a form, subscribing to our newsletter, or using our assessment, calculator, or booking tools, you agree to these terms. If you are accepting on behalf of an organisation, you confirm that you are authorised to do so.
2. What Orgainse Provides
Project Management as a Service (PMaaS): structured project leadership, governance, reporting cadence, risk and dependency management, stakeholder communication, and executive visibility.
Artificial Intelligence and workflow transformation: process mapping, opportunity identification, human approval design, and a sequenced implementation roadmap.
Delivery and operational governance: portfolio visibility, escalation paths, decision records, resource and cost oversight, and executive reporting.
ORQYNE implementation and adoption: workspace design, roles and access, workflow configuration, imports, templates, governance controls, integrations, onboarding, and adoption reviews.
Artificial Intelligence strategy and readiness: prioritisation, maturity assessment, data and governance review, and a phased plan.
Healthcare Revenue Intelligence Advisory: advisory and analytics on revenue performance, denial patterns, payer behaviour, controls, and executive reporting. This service is advisory only and expressly excludes operational medical billing, coding, collections, and claim submission.
3. Website Tools Are Informational
The Artificial Intelligence readiness assessment, the Return on Investment calculator, published checklists, guides, articles, and newsletter content are provided for general information and planning. They are directional, depend entirely on the assumptions and answers you supply, and are not a certification, an audit, a detailed assessment, or professional advice for your specific circumstances.
You should not act on website output alone. Material operational, financial, legal, security, healthcare, employment, or compliance decisions require appropriate professional review.
4. No Guarantee of Outcomes
Orgainse does not guarantee delivery improvement, cost reduction, revenue uplift, timeline compression, Return on Investment, or compliance outcomes. Results depend on engagement scope, data quality, leadership decisions, user adoption, integration availability, operating conditions, and the customer's own responsibilities. Success measures, assumptions, and review points are agreed in writing before work begins and are reviewed during the engagement.
